changelog.body:
First release.

Themes badged shortcut icons (contacts, cloned/work-profile, app shortcuts) by nulling `IconOptions.setSourceHint` so they take the launcher's themed icon path. Does not remove the badge.

Verified on Android 16 / SDK 36 (com.android.launcher3).

After enabling + reboot: remove already-placed badged icons from your home screen and re-add them so they rebuild through the themed path.

# 🎨 ThemeBadgedIcons **An LSPosed module that makes your themed (monochrome) icons apply to _badged_ shortcut icons too — without removing the badge.** [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Android%2012%E2%80%9316-3DDC84?logo=android&logoColor=white)](#) [![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/framework-LSPosed-blue)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [![minSdk](https://img.shields.io/badge/minSdk-28-orange)](#) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) [![Type](https://img.shields.io/badge/hooks-runtime%20only%20(no%20overlays)-purple)](#)
--- ## ✨ What it does On modern Android (12+, reworked on 16), the launcher **skips icon-theming for badged shortcut icons** — contact shortcuts, cloned / work-profile icons, and app-shortcut icons. The result: those icons stay full-color while everything else on your home screen is nicely themed, and only the **badge** picks up the theme. **ThemeBadgedIcons fixes that.** It removes the launcher's "don't theme this, it's a raw file drawable" signal, so badged icons get run through the normal themed path just like every other icon. > [!IMPORTANT] > This module does **NOT** remove the badge. The badge stays exactly where it is — > the *underlying icon* simply becomes themed to match the rest of your set. | Before | After | |:---:|:---:| | | | | Badged icons stay full color, unthemed | Badged icons are **themed** (badge kept) | --- ## 🔍 How it works (verified from the launcher's own bytecode) Disassembled from the device's real launcher (`Launcher3QuickStep.apk`, Android 16 / SDK 36): 1. When building a shortcut icon, the launcher calls: ```java IconOptions.setSourceHint(SourceHint) ``` `SourceHint` carries the original app's `ComponentKey` **and** an `isFileDrawable` flag. 2. `MonoIconThemeController.createThemedBitmap(..., SourceHint)` reads that flag: ```smali if-eqz p4, :cond_2c # if SourceHint == null -> skip invoke-virtual {p4}, SourceHint;->isFileDrawable()Z move-result v3 # v3 = isFileDrawable :cond_2c move v9, v3 # getMonochromeDrawable(..., isFileDrawable) isFileDrawable == true => SKIP theming ``` 3. Badged icons are raw file / bitmap drawables → `isFileDrawable == true` → the theme controller **bails out** of the monochrome/themed path. ### The hook Null the argument to `IconOptions.setSourceHint(...)`: ```java findAndHookMethod IconOptions.setSourceHint(SourceHint) { before { param.args[0] = null; } // no SourceHint => isFileDrawable defaults to false } ``` With no `SourceHint`, `isFileDrawable` defaults to `false`, so the launcher themes the icon normally. The badge is drawn separately, afterwards, so it's untouched. All hooks are **scoped to the launcher process only** and are **pure runtime method hooks** — no overlays, no resource edits — so this coexists cleanly with a custom ROM's built-in Iconify/overlay theming (different layer entirely). --- ## 📦 Install & activate 1. **Install** [`ThemeBadgedIcons-release.apk`](ThemeBadgedIcons-release.apk). 2. Open **LSPosed → Modules → ThemeBadgedIcons → enable**. 3. **Scope** it to your launcher (e.g. `com.android.launcher3`). 4. **Reboot** your device. > [!WARNING] > ### 🔁 After reboot: refresh existing badged icons > Icons the launcher already cached **won't change automatically** — you need to > rebuild them once. > > #### ✅ Easiest way (recommended) > Go to **Settings → Wallpaper & style → Themed icons** and toggle it > **off, then on**. This rebuilds *every* icon through the hooked path at once — > no need to touch your layout. > > #### Alternative (per-icon) > For a specific badged shortcut (contacts, app shortcuts, cloned/work icons), > **remove it from your home screen, then add it again** — the freshly-created > shortcut is built through the hooked path and comes out themed. > > (Clearing the launcher's storage/cache + rebooting also works, but that wipes your layout — use the toggle instead.) 5. Verify it engaged: ```bash adb logcat -d | grep ThemeBadgedIcons # [ThemeBadgedIcons] Hooked com.android.launcher3.icons.BaseIconFactory$IconOptions.setSourceHint (force-theme badged icons) ``` --- ## 🛠️ Build from source **Requirements:** Android SDK (compileSdk 34), JDK 17, and the Xposed API jar at `app/libs/api-82.jar`. ```bash ./gradlew assembleRelease # APK -> app/build/outputs/apk/release/ ```
SDK-tools build path (used to produce the shipped APK, no Gradle) ```bash javac -> compile ThemeHook.java + BadgeThemer.java (cp android.jar:api-82.jar) d8 -> classes.dex aapt2 -> compile res + link (manifest + assets + resources.arsc) zip -> add classes.dex zipalign -p 4 apksigner sign (debug keystore) ```
--- ## 🧩 Compatibility & tuning - Built and confirmed on **Android 16 / SDK 36**, AOSP/LineageOS `com.android.launcher3`. - The scope list in [`app/src/main/res/values/xposed_scope.xml`](app/src/main/res/values/xposed_scope.xml) covers common launchers; add your launcher's package if it's missing. - If `logcat` shows `setSourceHint NOT FOUND`, your launcher uses a differently-named `IconOptions` class — open an issue with the log and it can be added. --- ## 📁 Project structure ``` ThemeBadgedIcons/ ├── build.gradle · settings.gradle · gradle.properties └── app/ ├── build.gradle ├── libs/api-82.jar └── src/main/ ├── AndroidManifest.xml # xposedmodule meta + scope (inside ) ├── assets/xposed_init # idali.themebadgedicons.ThemeHook ├── res/values/xposed_scope.xml # launcher packages └── java/idali/themebadgedicons/ ├── ThemeHook.java # scope gate + entry point └── BadgeThemer.java # the setSourceHint hook ``` --- ## 📜 History Originally prototyped as **NoShortcutBadge** with the intent to *remove* the source-app badge. It turned out that nulling `SourceHint` doesn't remove the badge at all — it makes badged icons get **themed**, which was the real goal. So it was renamed to match what it actually does. ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © daliboss
readmeZh: # 🎨 主题徽章图标 **一个 LSPosed 模块，使您的主题（单色）图标也适用于 _badged_ 快捷方式图标 - 无需删除徽章。** [![平台](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Android%2012%E2%80%9316-3DDC84?logo=android&logoColor=white)](#) [![框架](https://img.shields.io/badge/framework-LSPosed-blue)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [![minSdk](https://img.shields.io/badge/minSdk-28-orange)](#) [![许可证](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](许可证) [![类型](https://img.shields.io/badge/hooks-runtime%20only%20(no%20overlays)-purple)](#) --- ## ✨ 它有什么作用 在现代 Android（12+，在 16 上重新设计）上，启动器 ** 会跳过图标主题 带标记的快捷方式图标** — 联系人快捷方式、克隆/工作配置文件图标以及 应用程序快捷方式图标。结果：这些图标保持全彩，而其他一切 您的主屏幕上有很好的主题，只有 **徽章** 选择该主题。 **ThemeBadgedIcons 修复了这个问题。** 它删除了启动器的“不要主题化，它是 原始文件可绘制”信号，因此带有标记的图标可以在正常主题中运行 路径就像其他图标一样。 > [!重要] > 该模块**不**删除徽章。徽章准确地留在原来的位置 - > *底层图标*只是简单地变成主题以匹配您的集合的其余部分。 |之前 |之后| |:---:|:---:| | | | |带徽章的图标保持全彩，无主题 |带徽章的图标是**主题**（保留徽章）| --- ## 🔍 它是如何工作的（从启动器自己的字节码验证） 从设备的真实启动器中反汇编（`Launcher3QuickStep.apk`，Android 16 / SDK 36）： 1.构建快捷方式图标时，启动器调用： ``java IconOptions.setSourceHint(SourceHint) ```` `SourceHint` 携带原始应用程序的 `ComponentKey` **和** `isFileDrawable` 标志。 2. `MonoIconThemeController.createThemedBitmap(..., SourceHint)` 读取该标志： ````斯马里 if-eqz p4, :cond_2c # if SourceHint == null -> 跳过 调用虚拟{p4}，SourceHint;->isFileDrawable()Z 移动结果 v3 # v3 = isFileDrawable :cond_2c 移动 v9、v3 # getMonochromeDrawable(..., isFileDrawable) isFileDrawable == true => 跳过主题 ```` 3. 带标记的图标是原始文件/位图可绘制对象 → `isFileDrawable == true` → 主题控制器**摆脱**单色/主题路径。 ### 钩子 将 `IconOptions.setSourceHint(...)` 的参数设为 Null： ``java findAndHookMethod IconOptions.setSourceHint(SourceHint) { 之前 { param.args[0] = null; } // 没有 SourceHint => isFileDrawable 默认为 false } ```` 如果没有“SourceHint”，“isFileDrawable”默认为“false”，因此启动器主题 图标正常。徽章是事后单独绘制的，因此没有受到影响。 所有钩子**仅限于启动器进程**并且是**纯运行时方法 钩子** - 没有覆盖，没有资源编辑 - 所以这与自定义干净地共存 ROM 的内置 Iconify/overlay 主题（完全不同的层）。 --- ## 📦 安装并激活 1. **安装** [`ThemeBadgedIcons-release.apk`](ThemeBadgedIcons-release.apk)。 2. 打开 **LSPosed → 模块 → ThemeBadgedIcons → 启用**。 3.**范围**它到您的启动器（例如“com.android.launcher3”）。 4. **重新启动**您的设备。 > [!警告] > ### 🔁 重启后：刷新现有标记图标 > 启动器已缓存的图标 **不会自动更改** — 您需要 > 重建一次。 > > #### ✅ 最简单的方法（推荐） > 转到 **设置 → 壁纸和样式 → 主题图标** 并切换它 > **关闭，然后打开**。这会通过挂钩路径立即重建*每个*图标 - > 无需修改您的布局。 > > #### 替代方案（每个图标） > 对于特定的标记快捷方式（联系人、应用程序快捷方式、克隆/工作图标）， > **将其从主屏幕中删除，然后再次添加** — 新创建的 > 快捷方式是通过挂钩路径构建的，并以主题形式出现。 > > （清除启动器的存储/缓存+重新启动也可以，但这会擦除您的布局 - 请改用切换按钮。） 5. 验证其已启用： ````bash adb logcat -d | adb logcat -d | adb logcat -d | adb logcat -d | adb logcat -d | grep 主题BadgedIcons # [ThemeBadgedIcons] Hooked com.android.launcher3.icons.BaseIconFactory$IconOptions.setSourceHint（强制主题标记图标） ```` --- ## 🛠️ 从源代码构建 **要求：** Android SDK (compileSdk 34)、JDK 17 以及位于 `app/libs/api-82.jar`。 ````bash ./gradlew assembleRelease # APK -> 应用程序/构建/输出/apk/release/ ```` <详情> SDK-tools 构建路径（用于生成附带的 APK，无 Gradle） ````bash javac -> 编译 ThemeHook.java + BadgeThemer.java (cp android.jar:api-82.jar) d8 -> 类.dex aapt2 -> 编译 res + 链接（清单 + 资产 + resources.arsc） zip -> 添加classes.dex zipalign -p 4 apksigner 签名（调试密钥库） ```` --- ## 🧩 兼容性和调整 - 在 **Android 16 / SDK 36**、AOSP/LineageOS `com.android.launcher3` 上构建并确认。 - [`app/src/main/res/values/xposed_scope.xml`](app/src/main/res/values/xposed_scope.xml) 中的范围列表 涵盖常见的发射器；如果缺少启动器包，请添加它。 - 如果“logcat”显示“setSourceHint NOT FOUND”，则您的启动器使用不同名称的 `IconOptions` 类 — 使用日志打开问题并可以添加它。 --- ## 📁 项目结构 ```` 主题BadgedIcons/ ├── build.gradle · 设置.gradle · gradle.properties └── 应用程序/ ├── 构建.gradle ├── libs/api-82.jar └── src/main/ ├── AndroidManifest.xml # xposedmodule 元 + 范围（ 内） ├── asset/xposed_init # idali.themebadgedicons.ThemeHook ├── res/values/xposed_scope.xml # 启动器包 └── java/idali/themebadgedicons/ ├── ThemeHook.java # 范围门 + 入口点 └── BadgeThemer.java # setSourceHint 钩子 ```` --- ## 📜 历史 最初原型为**NoShortcutBadge**，目的是*删除* 源应用程序徽章。事实证明，清空 `SourceHint` 并不会删除徽章 完全如此——它使带有徽章的图标变得**主题化**，这才是真正的目标。原来如此 重命名以匹配其实际用途。 ## 📄 许可证 [麻省理工学院]（许可）© daliboss
